title: The flag up
logline: Christmas Eve: the mailbox with its flag up. He's mailed something. To whom, the page doesn't say. The crab beside the word in the margin.

margin.note: The crab, small, beside the word.

panels.composition: A roadside mailbox at dusk with its red flag raised, the door shut, rain on the road, a porch light far back. The flag the page's one red.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a roadside mailbox at dusk with its red flag raised and door shut, a wet road and a distant porch light, the flag the only red on the page, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
